questions.q: Ms. Ito asked ______ to prepare the slides for Monday's meeting.
questions.exp: 空格在動詞 asked 後面，是受詞，用受格 me。

questions.q: The interns presented ______ ideas to the board.
questions.exp: 空格後面接名詞 ideas，要所有格形容詞 their；theirs 不放在名詞前面。

questions.q: Nobody helped Mr. Park; he repaired the printer by ______.
questions.exp: by＋反身代名詞＝獨自、沒人幫忙：by himself。

questions.q: Everyone in the office ______ to update the software by Friday.
questions.exp: everyone 是不定代名詞，接單數動詞 needs；needing、to need 不是有時態的動詞。

questions.q: The cost of the new machines ______ higher than we expected.
questions.exp: 主詞是 cost（單數），of the new machines 只是修飾；expected 是過去，用 was。

questions.q: The manager, along with two engineers, ______ visiting the factory tomorrow.
questions.exp: along with 開頭的片語不影響動詞，主詞是 manager（單數），用 is。

questions.q: There ______ three candidates waiting in the lobby right now.
questions.exp: there is／there are 看 be 後面的名詞：three candidates 是複數，用 are。

questions.q: Five years ______ a long time to wait for a promotion.
questions.exp: 一段時間當成一個整體，用單數 is，雖然 years 是複數。

questions.q: Neither the CEO nor the board members ______ aware of the problem last month.
questions.exp: neither A nor B 一單一複時，動詞跟靠近的那個；board members 是複數，last month 是過去，用 were。

questions.q: The two departments should communicate with ______ more often.
questions.exp: 兩個部門互相溝通，用 each other；沒有 each others、each another 這種說法，themselves 是各自跟自己溝通，意思不通。
